title: Upgrade React Native 0.73 → 0.74: Kotlin, AGP, and Gradle wrapper pair
prompt: React Native 0.74 requires Kotlin 1.9.24, Android Gradle Plugin 8.6.0, and Gradle wrapper 8.8. After the upgrade this project still pins the old 0.73 pair (Kotlin 1.8.22, AGP 8.1.0, wrapper 8.1.1) and the Gradle build fails with version-incompatibility errors. Fix android/build.gradle (kotlinVersion + AGP classpath) and android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties (distributionUrl) to the RN 0.74 requirements. Return each changed file with its complete new content.
